screens.title: Welcome to Karv
screens.subtitle: Build habits that last. Every habit costs energy. Repeat it, and it gets easier.

screens.title: Your Daily Energy
screens.subtitle: 100 energy each day. Each habit costs some. Bad sleep? Low day? Tap the gauge to match your real energy.

screens.title: Mastery Milestones
screens.subtitle: The more you show up, the easier it gets. You'll unlock milestones that drop the energy cost.

screens.title: Keep your streak alive
screens.subtitle: Get gentle reminders so you never miss twice.

variables.name: Habit completions
variables.description: Times a single habit has been completed. PER-HABIT, not global — see the per-entity gap in docs/01-json-contract.md.

milestones.label: First Spark
milestones.hint: You've beaten the hardest part - starting. Your brain now recognizes this as a pattern.

milestones.label: Week Anchor
milestones.hint: A full week! Your brain is building new neural pathways for this habit.

milestones.label: The Shift
milestones.hint: Two weeks in - your body has physically adapted. The resistance you felt on day 1 is lower. If it feels easier, consider adjusting the energy.

milestones.label: The Groove
milestones.hint: Your brain just automated this. It moved from effortful thinking to autopilot - that's real neurological change.

milestones.label: Second Nature
milestones.hint: This is now unconscious competence. You do it without thinking. Be careful not to go on autopilot - keep paying attention to quality.

milestones.label: Autopilot
milestones.hint: Science says 66 days is the median for full automaticity. This habit is now wired into who you are.

milestones.label: Carved
milestones.hint: 100 times. You didn't just build a habit - you carved it into your identity. This is mastery.
